body: Drake really called out his producer for wearing a garmin watch Via: @champagnepapi During his stream last night, Drake noticed his producer wearing a Garmin watch and had to call it out “This dude got on a Garmin watch,” he joked, turning the watch into the topic of a quick back-and-forth. It came across as playful teasing between the two, with Drake poking fun at his producer’s choice of watch. Garmin or Apple Watch which one are you wearing?
